prose: Forging ahead into episode 4 of Marvel's Loki TV series with cohost Slick Dissident, "The Nexus Event" installment is once again dripping with synchromystic clues and symbols. Themes include the myth of Narcissus, the Devil (card) and Kronos, sacred mountains, the Word of God, and the civil war in heaven. Sure to be educational and fun even if you're not up to speed on the show we're examining, but for maximum comprehension, catch up on our whole series!
